metadata.underlying: 1-3 month US Treasury bills cash proxy
metadata.price_reconstruction: Multiply each pre-split Yahoo OHLC by product of later split ratios; do not use adjclose.
metadata.dividend_basis: Yahoo split-normalized cash dividend multiplied by subsequent split factors
metadata.action_coverage_evidence: Yahoo events=div,splits requested for entire price interval; complete means provider-reported coverage, not independent exchange verification
metadata.availability_convention: Following local calendar day 00:00 after conservative session-close bound; inferred market observability, not archived server timestamp
metadata.session_clock_method: ZoneInfo normal-session clock. Close is conservative full-day bound on half days; no complete historical halt/calendar audit.
metadata.revision_risk: Provider correction/backfill possible; original vintages unavailable; source bytes now frozen
metadata.survivorship_risk: Fixed currently surviving ETF/index sample; no market-universe inference or delisted-asset coverage
limitations: No dividend payment dates; exdate reinvestment convention only
No historical costs, bid-ask, halts or FX execution
Index level is price return only and not a directly executable investment
